subject: POC planning & risk tracking - FinTechCorp evaluation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-05T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + POC next steps (FinTechCorp)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed plan for the 4-week POC so we can align on success criteria and owners.

Call highlights:
- Primary goal: validate that Redwood can serve peak inference latency < 250ms p95 for the customer scoring model, at your test load (~50 concurrent sessions).
- Secondary goal: verify embeddings similarity quality for search re-ranking (~90% parity vs current baseline).
- Data flow: model runs in Redwood Dedicated (us-west), inputs pass through customer VPC peering.

Proposed POC plan (high level):
1) Week 0: Access + infra setup (VPN + service account + test dataset) — owner: FinTechCorp (Samantha/Tom) + Redwood infra
2) Week 1: Baseline runs + smoke validation — owner: Redwood (Dev) + FinTechCorp
3) Week 2: Stress runs + quality evals — owner: Redwood (Rishi) + FinTechCorp
4) Week 3: Fixes, regression checks, final validation — owner: joint

Success criteria (draft — attached spreadsheet):
- Latency: p95 < 250ms for 90% of test cases
- Throughput: sustain 50 concurrent sessions for 10 minutes without errors
- Functional parity: embedding-based re-rank MRR within 10% of baseline
- No critical errors or data leakage incidents

Risks we discussed: possible model output mismatches for enriched input fields; dependency on VPC peering timing; and potential edge-case tokenization differences. We'll track these in a shared log and agree on escalation paths.

Attachments: fintechcorp_poc_success_criteria.xlsx (draft success criteria + timeline)

Next steps:
- Can you confirm the timeline and owners above?
- Please share a sanitized test dataset and the contact for your network/infra team for peering (Tom?).
- We'll schedule a kickoff for Monday 4/12 to start Week 0 if that works.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0199

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintechcorp.com>
Date: 2026-04-06T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + POC next steps (FinTechCorp)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan and the spreadsheet; we're aligned on the goals. Confirming owners: Tom will help with peering and infra, I'll own the dataset and evaluation.

Couple of notes from our side after a quick internal run:
- Timeline: 4/12 kickoff works for us.
- Dataset: we'll share a sanitized sample by EOD Friday (4/9).
- Risk: during a smoke run we observed a sporadic mismatch where the scoring output for requests with padded metadata returned lower confidence scores (appears non-deterministic). Not blocking yet, but we flagged it.

Tom, can you confirm when you can be available for a short peering call next week?

Also, for the issue above, what logs would you need from our side? We can collect debug traces and tokenized inputs if helpful.

-Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of ML Engineering, FinTechCorp
samantha.lee@fintechcorp.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-08T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + POC next steps (FinTechCorp) — tracking potential scoring non-determinism

Team —

Saw Samantha's note about the sporadic lower confidence scores on padded metadata inputs. I'm starting a short triage run to reproduce. Plan / ask:

1) Reproduce locally against the same model + tokenization pipeline. Owner: Dev. ETA: 24-48h.
2) If reproduced, check KV-cache behavior and any padding-related token merges (likely places to look). Owner: Rishi. ETA: 48-72h.
3) Collect traces from FinTechCorp: sample inputs (tokenized), model logits, and timestamps for the failing requests. Owner: Marissa to request from Samantha.
4) Mitigation (if reproduces): pin to a stable tokenization config + apply a guarded fallback that strips padded metadata before scoring; rollout as a canary for the POC. Owner: Dev + Rishi. ETA: 3 business days from repro.
5) Escalation path: if we can't repro within 72h or if mitigation impacts correctness, escalate to Eng Lead (Neha) and Product (Alex) to decide on temporary skip criteria or Pausing POC.

I'll attach a short log extract once I have one (root_cause_log.txt). For now, please confirm if we should set up a temporary canary that strips metadata padding during the POC before we have a full root cause. My vote: enable the safe strip as short-term mitigation so the customer can continue validation while we investigate.

Thanks —
Dev
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintechcorp.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Finalized kickoff plan + risk tracking (POC starts today)

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Kickoff is on for today. Per our internal triage we have the following agreed actions:

- FinTechCorp: share the sanitized sample dataset + tokenized examples (Samantha) — expected 4/09 (received: yes)
- Redwood infra: will enable a canary strip of padded metadata for scoring during the POC window to avoid the non-determinism while we investigate (Owner: Dev) — canary enabled 4/12 08:00 PT
- Root cause investigation: reproduce -> KV-cache/tokenization checks (Owner: Rishi/Dev) — ETA 72h
- Escalation: If we cannot reproduce or mitigation causes correctness regressions, Neha (Eng Lead) will be notified and we will pause the POC and present recommended next steps to FinTechCorp.

For visibility, we've uploaded the tracking doc and a short logs extract to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C. Attachment: root_cause_log.txt contains the initial triage snippet.

Please confirm you have the canary in place and that you can continue with the validation tests. If you run into any functional mismatches related to stripping metadata, flag immediately and we'll revert.

Proposed next sync: 2026-04-15 10:00 PT — 30min status + go/no-go check.

Appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
